description:
KOEI TECMO America and developer Team NINJA announce that Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember, the latest installment in their dark Three Kingdoms action RPG series, will be released worldwide March 4, 2027, on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC. The title will also be available day one with Game Pass across XBOX and PC. 

Fans can jump into the action early with the limited-time Alpha Demo, beginning today on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC. 

In this long-awaited sequel to Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty, which has surpassed over 8 million players worldwide, players must master the evolved Chinese martial arts and conquer battlefields of the Three Kingdoms overrun by monstrous demons alongside renowned heroes who left their mark on history.

The loop always resets. You don't. 🧠🛰️
Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. 
You play as Miranda, a researcher stuck in an infinite time loop aboard the A.R.E.S. space station. Your crew has vanished, leaving only their journals, recordings, and personal belongings behind. Explore the station and solve puzzles to piece together what happened.
